name: RAGatouille
description: Easily use and train state of the art late-interaction retrieval methods (ColBERT) in any RAG pipeline. Designed for modularity and ease-of-use, backed by research.
editorialSummary: RAGatouille wraps ColBERT late-interaction retrieval so teams can drop research-grade reranking/retrieval into existing RAG stacks. It focuses on training and serving ColBERT indexes with a simple API.
whyCare: When dense embedding search is not enough, ColBERT via RAGatouille often lifts answer quality with relatively little pipeline churn.
notes: Last push observed mid-2025; still widely referenced for ColBERT-in-RAG.

name: Haystack
description: Open-source AI orchestration framework for building context-engineered, production-ready LLM applications. Design modular pipelines and agent workflows with explicit control over retrieval, routing, memory, and generation.
editorialSummary: Haystack is a production-oriented pipeline framework for RAG, semantic search, and agent workflows with explicit component graphs. deepset designed it for controllable retrieval, routing, and evaluation rather than opaque chains.
whyCare: Choose Haystack when you need modular, inspectable RAG/agent pipelines with strong IR roots and enterprise deployment patterns.

name: LangChain
editorialSummary: LangChain remains the most widely adopted LLM application framework, with first-class RAG primitives (retrievers, document loaders, vector store integrations) alongside agent tooling. Listed here for its retrieval ecosystem even as the project positions itself around agent engineering.
whyCare: Its retriever/vector-store ecosystem and tutorials make it the default starting point for many RAG prototypes and production apps.
notes: Primary product messaging is agent-centric; included for RAG-centric integrations and retriever abstractions.

name: txtai
description: All-in-one AI framework for semantic search, LLM orchestration and language model workflows
editorialSummary: txtai is an all-in-one embeddings + semantic search + RAG workflow library with a built-in vector index. It targets teams that want embeddings, retrieval, and LLM pipelines without assembling many separate services.
whyCare: Great fit for compact semantic-search and RAG apps where an embedded vector index plus orchestration in one package reduces stack complexity.

name: Onyx
description: Open Source AI Platform - AI Chat with advanced features that works with every LLM
editorialSummary: Onyx (formerly Danswer) is a self-hosted enterprise search and AI chat platform with connectors into workplace knowledge sources. It emphasizes permission-aware retrieval and production chat UX over raw library APIs.
whyCare: The strongest open-source option for company-internal RAG: connectors, ACL-aware search, and a full chat product you can self-host.
notes: Formerly danswer-ai/danswer; GitHub license SPDX unresolved (NOASSERTION).

name: Quivr
description: Opiniated RAG for integrating GenAI in your apps. Focus on your product rather than the RAG. Easy integration in existing products with customisation.
editorialSummary: Quivr provides an opinionated RAG stack (APIs, UI patterns, vector store choices) aimed at product teams embedding knowledge chat into apps. It abstracts LLM and vector-store selection behind a product-oriented interface.
whyCare: Useful when you want a ready-made RAG product layer instead of assembling loaders, stores, and chat UI from scratch.
notes: GitHub license SPDX unresolved (NOASSERTION); activity slowed after mid-2025.

name: LlamaIndex
description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
editorialSummary: LlamaIndex is the go-to Python framework for connecting LLMs to private data via indexing, retrieval, and query engines. It covers ingestion connectors, vector/graph stores, agentic RAG patterns, and evaluation utilities used across production knowledge systems.
whyCare: If you are building document Q&A, knowledge agents, or multi-source RAG pipelines in Python, LlamaIndex offers the deepest retrieval-centric abstractions and ecosystem of integrations.

name: PrivateGPT
description: Complete API layer for private AI applications on local models: RAG, skills, tools, MCP, text-to-sql, and more. Works with any OpenAI-compatible inference server.
editorialSummary: PrivateGPT popularized private, document-local RAG with a complete API over local or OpenAI-compatible models. It now extends into tools, MCP, and text-to-SQL while keeping privacy-first defaults.
whyCare: Ideal when documents must stay on-prem and you want a ready API for private RAG rather than wiring inference and retrieval yourself.
